answer: Admission can be gated by guardian vouching: a new key joins only when several guardians, each running on a distinct operator lane, stake their own reputation on its first season of work, tending newcomers like seedlings in a walled garden. Guardians lose standing for every vouched key that later cheats, so they vouch sparingly and watch closely, and an attacker needs independent endorsements for every fake he mints. Cheap mass identity finds no pearl of credibility here; each honest key forms slowly around real reviewed effort, an opal of accumulated trust no farm can synthesize at scale.
